//: The agent registry. This file is the ONLY place a provider name appears in the collaboration layer: the protocol routes by role and capability, never by agent id, so swapping who reviews what is an edit here and nothing else. Adding a third agent is one more entry plus, if it needs one, a role in roles.json.
//briefing: `briefing` is the agent's own instructions, returned by its whoami call. Instructions travel WITH the registration so a new agent does not need a new prompt file wired into a new place.
//adapter: `adapter.kind` is how a message physically reaches the agent. 'manual' = it lands in the inbox and the agent reads it when its session runs. 'cli' = the layer could spawn it; `enabled:false` means it will not, and doctor reports the binary state either way.
